name: SIGMA - PowerShell Launched With an Encoded Command
description:
Detects powershell.exe / pwsh.exe started with the -EncodedCommand parameter (or any of
its accepted abbreviations such as -enc, -ec, -e). The parameter takes a Base64-encoded
UTF-16LE script, which attackers use to avoid quoting problems and to hide the payload
from casual inspection of command lines. The windash modifier also matches the "/" and
Unicode-dash variants that PowerShell accepts as parameter prefixes.

query_string.query: data.win.system.eventID:1 AND (((data.win.eventdata.image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) OR (data.win.eventdata.originalFileName:(PowerShell.EXE OR pwsh.dll))) AND (data.win.eventdata.commandLine:(*\ \-e\ * OR *\ \/e\ * OR *\ –e\ * OR *\ —e\ * OR *\ ―e\ *) OR data.win.eventdata.commandLine:(*\ \-ec\ * OR *\ \/ec\ * OR *\ –ec\ * OR *\ —ec\ * OR *\ ―ec\ *) OR data.win.eventdata.commandLine:(*\ \-en\ * OR *\ \/en\ * OR *\ –en\ * OR *\ —en\ * OR *\ ―en\ *) OR data.win.eventdata.commandLine:(*\ \-enc\ * OR *\ \/enc\ * OR *\ –enc\ * OR *\ —enc\ * OR *\ ―enc\ *) OR data.win.eventdata.commandLine:(*\ \-enco* OR *\ \/enco* OR *\ –enco* OR *\ —enco* OR *\ ―enco*)))
